claims.statement: sub_141671540 takes a physical row ordinal and tail-calls sub_140462700 with the resource pointer loaded from static VA 0x145012128. The generic getter checks ordinal < resource dword+0xB8 and returns resource qword+0xC8[ordinal], else zero.

The separate sub_141671510(slot,key) rejects keys 0xFFFFFFFF and 0x7FFF then tail-calls sub_140279740(main+0x127E8,slot,key). That getter handles slots 0..5, requires key < 0x2EF, and selects a qword at +8+slot*0x2EF0+key*8. sub_140279080 populates those arrays using each resource row byte+0xC and word+0x1E, not its physical ordinal or word+0x14.

claims.statement: The set wrapper sub_141672160(set_key) returns main+0x127E8+0x119A8+set_key*0x90 through sub_1402798A0; that getter itself has no bounds/readiness check. Construction initializes 0x2F0 such records with numeric key at +4. sub_140279300 groups armor pointers using armor word+0x14 into per-slot qwords beginning group+0x18.

cArmorData registration specifies size 0x48. Reader sub_1419b0210 checks magic 0x18091001/version word 0x5F, appends one native pointer per file row and invokes sub_140279de0. That mapper separately writes native dword+8, byte+0xC, byte+0x12, byte+0x13, word+0x14, word+0x1E and dword+0x28. +0x14 comes from temporary word+8; +0x1E comes from temporary word+0x3C.

Matching reader/serializer order to the packed 60-byte schema maps native row+8 to Index, +0xC to Equip_Slot, +0x12 to Variant, +0x13 to Type, +0x14 to Set_Layered_Id, +0x1E to Set_Group and +0x28 to Gender. Set_Group is a THIRD identifier domain, separate from physical row ordinal and Set_Layered_Id. These semantic names are a cross-source inference, not native debug-field names.

claims.statement: The isolated asset crosscheck finds real-set 480 rows [452,1071,1688,2297,2912], each Set_Group 530/type 0, versus layered-set 657 rows [627,1244,1859,2468,3083], each Set_Group 707/type 2. All are slots 0..4/model pair (129,0). Matching model fields do not make these three identifiers numerically equal.

Equipment-object resolver sub_140b1b9d0 returns zero for equipment dword+0x18 == 1; otherwise it passes equipment dword+0x20/+0x24 into slot/key lookup sub_141671510. This is a bridge from equipment objects to the slot/Set_Group-keyed table, not an inventory-iteration API or a complete equipment-tag enum.

uGUIEquipOuter registration sub_140037c30 uses DTI VA 0x144CCD020 and size 0x4CF0. Its allocator sub_140523680 calls constructor sub_140523950, which at VA 0x140523964/0x14052396B installs instance vtable VA 0x142FA77F8, DISTINCT from DTI vtable VA 0x142FA77C8. Static instance entries +0x20/+0x250/+0x2D0 point respectively to sub_140525bf0 (DTI accessor), sub_1405256b0 (UI initialization) and sub_140525370 (list building).

List builder sub_140525370 iterates keys 0..0x2EF through sub_1416721d0, retains group types 2/3 after other gates, consults sub_14134ce60, deduplicates group dword+4 and stores SET KEYS in two menu arrays (base +0x2990, stride 0xBC8; counts +0x3550). sub_140525cc0 resolves those keys through sub_141672160 and places displayed group pointers at menu+0x2920.

remaining_unknowns: Runtime values/readiness of main, resource, sUserData and actor candidates; slot 3 TEST, local-character identity and lifetimes. Static globals are not active pointers.
Complete inventory count/iterator, tag enum, empty/sentinel rules, equipped inclusion, duplicates and full-body ownership. Equipment +0x20/+0x24 bridge is insufficient.
Native acceptance of ordinary Set_Layered_Id values by menu/loadouts/serialization and of their Set_Group values for reversible visible appearance.
Canonical preview, committed and serialized state; rollback/cancel behavior through every selection and confirmation branch.
Thread provenance, callback dispatch contract, exact ABI/return widths, locking and context/object readiness.
Visual refresh scheduling/completion and safe snapshot/restore boundaries, pigments and unchanged pieces. No live visual proof exists.
Save/restart/reload and DLL-removed acceptance; multiplayer behavior and online safety.

Independently validate a hash-bound user-mode runtime profile, TEST identity/readiness, bounded ownership IDs, both appearance representations, preview/commit/cancel, refresh completion and game-thread provenance with paired vanilla observations. This artifact implies no launch/attachment/native-call/write permission.

calling_assumptions.statement: Small x64 row/slot-key/set-key wrapper shapes are leads only, not validated callable APIs. Several dereference singletons without readiness checks, and set lookup lacks a bound check.
Callback argument contract, trigger/event meaning, wrapper lifetime and preview/commit/cancel semantics. Registration at control+0x128 is observed; dispatch and thread provenance are not.

Observed ordinary menu caller setup is RCX=actor-candidate, EDX=1, R8B=0. Full ABI, parameter meanings, object lifecycle and asynchronous completion remain unvalidated. Do not call from an arbitrary worker.
Runtime singleton values, TEST slot/context, object/vtable identity and thread identity. Only STATIC VAs/RVAs are recorded.

limitations: Raw functions, IL, disassembly and refs are GUI BN observations. Names/types may include previous imported analysis; they are not independently trusted semantic names or ABI declarations.
Only bounded candidate ranges/references and catalog string matches were examined. Unfound callers/fields are unknown, not absent.
The database is the isolated MHW Mods copy; embedded original_filename still names the historical DLSS path. Both raw BN view and isolated unpacked source bytes SHA-256 match.
No BN name/type/comment edits, saves, close or retarget. No game launch/attachment, CE, native call, hook, process/save write, driver or bypass.
